import numpy as np
def _fx_midpoint_mesh(z_min, z_max, n_bins):
    n = int(n_bins)
    edges = np.linspace(float(z_min), float(z_max), n + 1)
    mids = 0.5 * (edges[:-1] + edges[1:])
    widths = np.full(n, (float(z_max) - float(z_min)) / n)
    return np.vstack([mids, widths])
mesh = _fx_midpoint_mesh(0.01, 1.5, 300)
z, w = mesh[0], mesh[1]
width = -0.1
def run_model():
    try:
        growth_kernel(z, width)
        return 0
    except ValueError:
        return 1
assert np.allclose(run_model(), target)
